customSections.label: What Changed for WSFCS in 2026–27
customSections.content:
The Board of Education rescinded the previously approved traditional calendar and adopted a Modified Start Student Calendar with an August 10 first day instead of August 24.

The modified-start schedule allows high schools to hold first-semester exams before Winter Break.

School starts August 10, three days earlier than the August 13 opening in 2025–26. The 2026–27 calendar is scheduled to end May 21. In 2025–26, the school year ultimately ended May 27 after a May 1 closure was added to the calendar.

Spring Break moves from March 9–13 in 2025–26 to March 26–April 2 in 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: Are December 21–22 and January 4 guaranteed days off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Those dates are scheduled within Winter Break, but WSFCS also designates them as possible snow make-up days. Check district updates after any weather closure.

calendarFaqs.q: What happens to the A/B schedule after a weather closure?
calendarFaqs.a: WSFCS says the missed A/B day designation is made up when the missed school day is made up. Each semester begins with an A day.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does the WSFCS 2026–27 school year start on August 10?
calendarFaqs.a: The Board of Education replaced the previously approved traditional calendar with the Modified Start Student Calendar. The earlier start allows high schools to hold first-semester exams before Winter Break.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded WSFCS calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import, not a live subscription. If WSFCS revises the calendar or activates a snow make-up day, previously imported dates will not update automatically.

sourceReviewSummary: Last checked August 10, 2026, against the official WSFCS Modified Start Student Calendar, calendar page, and Board adoption announcement.
sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the August 10 first day, May 21 last day, 178 student days, four quarter endings, teacher professional days, major breaks, return dates, and listed snow make-up dates against the official student calendar.
WSFCS's official calendar page separately publishes the Early/Middle College Calendar, middle and high school A/B Day Calendar, Spanish student calendar, and staff calendar.

The Board adoption announcement confirms that WSFCS rescinded the previously approved traditional calendar and adopted the Modified Start Calendar, which allows high schools to hold exams before Winter Break.
The April 22, 2026 Board update confirms that May 27 became the 2025–26 last day after the May 1 closure was added to the calendar.
The .ics file is a one-time import, not a live subscription. Imported dates do not update automatically after a district revision.
